answer: A practical defense is hardware-rooted identity: each agent vertex in the network must register with a key generated inside a device secure enclave that cannot be copied. Spawning ten thousand sybils then costs ten thousand physical devices instead of ten thousand free API calls. A genuine agent builds reputation like a pearl growing layer by layer around one irreplaceable core, and a harbor master can revoke a single misbehaving attested identity without harming honest neighbors.
